title: #036. Cumulative Resource Scheduling (RCPSP)
subtitle: Schedule a precedence DAG under a shared renewable power or crew capacity via cumulative(tasks, capacity).

judge.m0: Output must be an object { starts, makespan }.
judge.m3: Precedence violated: task {p0} finishes at {p1}, after task {p2} starts at {p3}.
judge.m4: Resource capacity exceeded at t = {p0}: active demand ({p1}) exceeds capacity ({p2}).
judge.m5: Reported makespan ({p0}) does not match max completion time ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid RCPSP schedule, but makespan ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
